entities.summary: Hamisha Daryani Ahuja is an Indian film producer, director, actress and businesswoman based in Nigeria. Ahuja made her directorial and acting debut in the Nollywood-Bollywood cross-cultural film Namaste Wahala. She also runs a chain of restaurants in Lagos.
